001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.inspection;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid.RaidIntel;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid.TravelStage;

009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;

011
012public class HITravelStage extends TravelStage {
013
014        public HITravelStage(RaidIntel raid, SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to, boolean requireNearTarget) {
015                super(raid, from, to, requireNearTarget);
016        }
017        
018        public void showStageInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
019                int curr = intel.getCurrentStage();
020                int index = intel.getStageIndex(this);
021                
022                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
023                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
024                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
025                float pad = 3f;
026                float opad = 10f;
027                
028                if (status == RaidStageStatus.FAILURE) {
029                        info.addPara("The inspection task force has failed to successfully reach the " +
030                                        intel.getSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + ". The inspection is now over.", opad);
031                } else if (curr == index) {
032                        info.addPara("The inspection task force is currently travelling to the " + 
033                                        intel.getSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + ".", opad);
034                }
035        }
036}
